title: Accessibility Validation
objective: Memvalidasi workflow nyata menggunakan keyboard, screen reader, scaling, contrast, reduced motion, dan fallback nonvisual.

keyboard_results.description: Keyboard navigation, shortcut, dan keyboard-only mode terdeteksi per platform.

screen_reader_results.description: Ketersediaan screen reader dan tipe reader (Narrator/VoiceOver/Orca) terdeteksi; fokus diumumkan.

scaling_results.description: Faktor skala platform dilaporkan dalam rentang wajar (>0, <=3).

contrast_results.description: Rasio kontras minimum memenuhi WCAG AA (>=4.5:1).

motion_results.description: Preferensi reduced motion dan durasi animasi terdeteksi.

nonvisual_results.description: Output nonvisual tersedia dan berlabel aksesibel per platform.

limits: Domain-level platform heuristics only. High-contrast query, reduced-motion OS query, dan deteksi screen reader aktif masih placeholder (komentar di source); verifikasi AT/NVDA/VoiceOver native, widget-level semantics, hosted CI, hardware, dan public release DEFERRED/UNVERIFIABLE.
